import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Set style
sns.set_palette("husl")

# 1. Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
occupation_sleep = data.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
ax1.barh(range(len(occupation_sleep)), occupation_sleep.values, color='steelblue')
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_sleep)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(occupation_sleep.index, fontsize=8)
ax1.set_xlabel('Avg Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=9)
ax1.set_title('Average Sleep Duration by Occupation', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Quality of Sleep vs Sleep Duration
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
scatter = ax2.scatter(data['Sleep Duration'], data['Quality of Sleep'], 
                     c=data['Stress Level'], cmap='YlOrRd', 
                     s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=9)
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=9)
ax2.set_title('Sleep Quality vs Duration (colored by Stress)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Stress Level', fontsize=8)
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 3. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
sleep_disorder_counts = data['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None').value_counts()
colors = ['#66b3ff', '#ff9999', '#99ff99']
ax3.pie(sleep_disorder_counts.values, labels=sleep_disorder_counts.index, 
        autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors)
ax3.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Physical Activity vs Daily Steps
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax4.scatter(data['Physical Activity Level'], data['Daily Steps'], 
           c=data['Age'], cmap='viridis', s=100, alpha=0.6, 
           edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax4.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=9)
ax4.set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=9)
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 5. BMI Category Distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
bmi_counts = data['BMI Category'].value_counts()
ax5.bar(range(len(bmi_counts)), bmi_counts.values, color='coral')
ax5.set_xticks(range(len(bmi_counts)))
ax5.set_xticklabels(bmi_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax5.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=9)
ax5.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Stress Level vs Heart Rate
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
ax6.scatter(data['Stress Level'], data['Heart Rate'], 
           s=100, alpha=0.6, color='indianred', 
           edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax6.set_xlabel('Stress Level', fontsize=9)
ax6.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=9)
ax6.set_title('Stress Level vs Heart Rate', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 7. Age Distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax7.hist(data['Age'], bins=10, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=9)
ax7.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=9)
ax7.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 8. Gender Distribution
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
gender_counts = data['Gender'].value_counts()
ax8.bar(gender_counts.index, gender_counts.values, color=['lightblue', 'lightpink'])
ax8.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=9)
ax8.set_title('Gender Distribution', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax8.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 9. Correlation Heatmap
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 
                'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = data[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, ax=ax9, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
ax9.set_title('Correlation Matrix', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax9.tick_params(labelsize=7)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Dataset Analysis', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
